formats.key: exactInput((bytes path, address recipient, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMinimum) params)
effects: The router pulls amountIn of the first token of the path from the signer (pay → safeTransferFrom) and swaps it through every pool in the path.
The recipient receives the last token of the path, at least amountOutMinimum, or the call reverts ('Too little received').
When the first token is WETH9 and ETH is attached, the router wraps the signer's ETH instead of pulling WETH. Extra ETH stays in the router unless the signer also calls refundETH.
recipient 0x…01 means the signer; recipient 0x…02 means the router keeps the output.
amountIn 0 means the router swaps its own balance and the signer pays nothing.
formats.shown: Swap: amount to send in the first path token, minimum to receive in the last path token, and the beneficiary address.

findings.title: exactInput is payable but has no @.value field, so ETH sent with the swap is never shown.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInput is `external payable`. PeripheryPayments.pay: `if (token == WETH9 && address(this).balance >= value) { IWETH9(WETH9).deposit{value: value}(); ...}`. The descriptor's exactInput fields are params.amountIn, params.amountOutMinimum and params.recipient only. No field has path @.value.
findings.fix: Add {"path":"@.value","label":"ETH sent","format":"amount"}. When WETH is the input, the signer pays in ETH, not WETH, so the screen must show the value.

findings.title: exactInput shows the recipient flags 0x…01 (signer) and 0x…02 (router) as raw addresses.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInputInternal: `if (recipient == Constants.MSG_SENDER) recipient = msg.sender; else if (recipient == Constants.ADDRESS_THIS) recipient = address(this);`. The Beneficiary field has no senderAddress.
findings.fix: Add "senderAddress": ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001"] to the Beneficiary params. Explain 0x…02 as 'Router (held for next step)'.

findings.title: exactInput shows amountIn 0 as '0 <token>', but 0 means the router spends its own balance.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInput: `if (params.amountIn == Constants.CONTRACT_BALANCE) { hasAlreadyPaid = true; ... balanceOf(address(this)); }` with CONTRACT_BALANCE = 0.
findings.fix: Add a message for the 0 value, such as 'Router balance', on the Amount to Send field.

cases.notes: 1020.349 SABAI out matches Amount to Send. 0.000905 WETH in is above the 0.000903 minimum. Beneficiary is the signer.

formats.key: exactInputSingle((address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee, address recipient, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMinimum, uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96) params)
effects: The router pulls up to amountIn of tokenIn from the signer and swaps it in the tokenIn/tokenOut pool with the given fee.
The recipient receives at least amountOutMinimum of tokenOut, or the call reverts.
When tokenIn is WETH9 and ETH is attached, the router wraps the signer's ETH instead of pulling WETH. Extra ETH stays in the router.
recipient 0x…01 means the signer; 0x…02 means the router keeps the output.
amountIn 0 means the router swaps its own balance.
formats.shown: swap: the amount sent in tokenIn, the minimum received in tokenOut, the pool fee in % and the beneficiary.

findings.title: exactInputSingle is payable but has no @.value field, so ETH paid for a WETH swap is hidden.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInputSingle is `external payable`. PeripheryPayments.pay wraps msg.value when token == WETH9. The descriptor fields are params.amountIn, params.amountOutMinimum, params.fee and params.recipient.

findings.title: exactInputSingle shows the recipient flags 0x…01 and 0x…02 as raw addresses.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactInputInternal replaces Constants.MSG_SENDER (address(1)) and ADDRESS_THIS (address(2)). The Beneficiary field has no senderAddress.

findings.title: exactInputSingle shows amountIn 0 as '0 <token>', but 0 means the router swaps its own balance.
findings.fix: Add a message for the 0 value on the Send field.

cases.notes: 0.00647 WETH out matches Send. 13.971 USDT in is above the 13.901 minimum. The reader read the pool fee as a fee charged, which is accurate.

formats.key: exactOutput((bytes path, address recipient, uint256 amountOut, uint256 amountInMaximum) params)
effects: The recipient receives exactly amountOut of the first token of the reversed path. The code requires amountOutReceived == amountOut.
The router pulls the needed amount of the last path token from the signer, at most amountInMaximum, or the call reverts ('Too much requested').
When the input token is WETH9 and ETH is attached, the router uses the signer's ETH. Extra ETH stays in the router.
recipient 0x…01 means the signer; 0x…02 means the router keeps the output.
formats.shown: Swap: the maximum amount in, in the last path token (with 'Unlimited' over 2^255), the amount to receive in the first path token, and the beneficiary.

findings.title: exactOutput is payable but has no @.value field, so ETH paid for the input is hidden.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactOutput is `external payable`. In uniswapV3SwapCallback, `pay(tokenOut, data.payer, msg.sender, amountToPay)` wraps msg.value when the token is WETH9. The descriptor fields are params.amountInMaximum, params.amountOut and params.recipient.

findings.title: exactOutput shows the recipient flags 0x…01 and 0x…02 as raw addresses.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactOutputInternal: `if (recipient == Constants.MSG_SENDER) recipient = msg.sender; else if (recipient == Constants.ADDRESS_THIS) recipient = address(this);`. The Beneficiary field has no senderAddress.

cases.notes: 0.00235 WETH out is below the 0.00236 maximum. Exactly 2636.31 SABAI in. The reversed path token slices are correct.
Synthetic. Max in renders as 'Unlimited WETH' from path[-20:] and receive 1000 USDT from path[0:20], which matches the code.

formats.key: exactOutputSingle((address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee, address recipient, uint256 amountOut, uint256 amountInMaximum, uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96) params)
effects: The recipient receives amountOut of tokenOut. The full amount is required only when sqrtPriceLimitX96 is 0.
The router pulls the needed amount of tokenIn from the signer, at most amountInMaximum.
When tokenIn is WETH9 and ETH is attached, the router uses the signer's ETH. Extra ETH stays in the router.
recipient 0x…01 means the signer; 0x…02 means the router keeps the output.
formats.shown: Swap: the maximum amount in, in tokenIn, the amount to receive in tokenOut, the pool fee and the beneficiary.

findings.title: exactOutputSingle is payable but has no @.value field, so ETH paid for the input is hidden.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactOutputSingle is `external payable`. PeripheryPayments.pay wraps msg.value when token == WETH9. The descriptor fields are params.amountInMaximum, params.amountOut, params.fee and params.recipient.

findings.title: exactOutputSingle hides sqrtPriceLimitX96. When it is not 0, the recipient can get less than 'Amount to Receive'.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactOutputInternal: `if (sqrtPriceLimitX96 == 0) require(amountOutReceived == amountOut);`. exactOutputSingle passes params.sqrtPriceLimitX96, and the descriptor has no field for it.
findings.fix: Add a field for params.sqrtPriceLimitX96, or relabel Amount to Receive as 'Up to' when the limit is not 0.

findings.title: exactOutputSingle shows the recipient flags 0x…01 and 0x…02 as raw addresses.
findings.evidence: V3SwapRouter.exactOutputInternal replaces Constants.MSG_SENDER and ADDRESS_THIS. The Beneficiary field has no senderAddress.

cases.notes: 0.000465 WETH out is below the 0.000509 maximum. Exactly 0.0134 QNT in.
Synthetic. 'Unlimited WETH' max in and 500 USDT out match the code.

formats.key: swapExactTokensForTokens(uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address[] path, address to)
effects: The router pulls amountIn of path[0] from the signer into the first V2 pair.
The 'to' address receives at least amountOutMin of path[last], measured as a balance change.
When path[0] is WETH9 and ETH is attached, the router wraps the signer's ETH instead of pulling WETH. Extra ETH stays in the router.
'to' 0x…01 means the signer; 0x…02 means the router.
amountIn 0 means the router swaps its own balance.
formats.shown: Swap: amount to send in path[0], minimum to receive in path[-1], and the recipient.

findings.title: swapExactTokensForTokens is payable but has no @.value field, so ETH paid for WETH input is hidden.
findings.evidence: V2SwapRouter.swapExactTokensForTokens is `external payable` and calls `pay(path[0], ...)`. PeripheryPayments.pay wraps msg.value when token == WETH9. The descriptor fields are amountIn, amountOutMin and to.

findings.title: swapExactTokensForTokens shows the 'to' flags 0x…01 and 0x…02 as raw addresses.
findings.evidence: V2SwapRouter.swapExactTokensForTokens: `if (to == Constants.MSG_SENDER) to = msg.sender; else if (to == Constants.ADDRESS_THIS) to = address(this);`. Its Recipient field has no senderAddress, but the sibling swapTokensForExactTokens has one.

findings.title: swapExactTokensForTokens shows amountIn 0 literally, but 0 means the router spends its own balance.
findings.evidence: V2SwapRouter.swapExactTokensForTokens: `if (amountIn == Constants.CONTRACT_BALANCE) { hasAlreadyPaid = true; amountIn = IERC20(path[0]).balanceOf(address(this)); }`.
findings.fix: Add a message for the 0 value on Amount to Send.

cases.notes: Synthetic, no mined tx. 1 WETH send, 2500 USDT minimum, which matches the code.

formats.key: swapTokensForExactTokens(uint256 amountOut, uint256 amountInMax, address[] path, address to)
effects: The router computes amountIn with getAmountsIn and pulls it from the signer, at most amountInMax.
The 'to' address receives amountOut of path[last] through the V2 pairs.
When path[0] is WETH9 and ETH is attached, the router uses the signer's ETH. Extra ETH stays in the router.
'to' 0x…01 means the signer; 0x…02 means the router.
formats.shown: Swap: amount to receive in path[-1], maximum to send in path[0] ('Unlimited' over 2^255), and the recipient, with 0x…01 shown as the sender.

findings.title: swapTokensForExactTokens is payable but has no @.value field, so ETH paid for WETH input is hidden.
findings.evidence: V2SwapRouter.swapTokensForExactTokens is `external payable` and calls `pay(path[0], msg.sender, ...)`. PeripheryPayments.pay wraps msg.value when token == WETH9. The descriptor fields are amountOut, amountInMax and to.

findings.title: swapTokensForExactTokens shows 'to' 0x…02 raw. That value means the router keeps the output.
findings.evidence: V2SwapRouter.swapTokensForExactTokens: `else if (to == Constants.ADDRESS_THIS) to = address(this);`. The Recipient field handles only senderAddress 0x…01.
findings.fix: Label 0x…02 as the router, for example through a local address name.

cases.notes: Synthetic. 'Unlimited WETH' maximum renders as the threshold says.
